contour.source: Regular dark circles and thick outlined segments dominate the path.
contour.candidate: Open mouths follow the dug neighbors. Closed cap, straight, bend, tee and cross contours are visible without phantom branches.

material.source: Uniform turquoise or mauve fill reads as flat tokens.
material.candidate: Gouache water, pale rock rims and amber excavated dirt match the authored pool and slab surfaces.

palette.source: Cyan and dusky purple compete with the painted receiver.
palette.candidate: Turquoise means connected and amber means dug but dry, with shared cream and warm plum edges.

light.source: A repeated semicircle is the only highlight.
light.candidate: Diffuse painted highlights follow the material. Straight components repeat a small glint pattern at native size.

perspective.source: Top-down schematic paths on a painted slab.
perspective.candidate: Top-down shallow channels align with the existing slab and pool view. Rotations preserve an overhead presentation.

scale.source: Wide dark borders dominate each cell.
scale.candidate: The bank and water are slimmer and still readable at 1280 and 1600 wide. Touch dimensions are unchanged.

contact.source: Flat segments collide with circular outlines at joints.
contact.candidate: Measured mouth pivots join the approved spring and sink. Slight band repetition at straight overlap is visible at native scale.

occlusion.source: Pool overlays hide some large endpoint markers.
occlusion.candidate: Pools remain above their channel joins. The actors and controls are outside the painted atlas footprint.

readability.source: Strong dry/wet color contrast, with graphic shapes that look separate from the scene.
readability.candidate: Small dents cue undug locations. Warm excavations and blue water remain distinct. Physical touch and child readability are open.

action_state.source: Flat dots, isolated dry regions, joined wet route and receiver transition.
action_state.candidate: Paired snapshots match. Branch states preserve dry/wet connectivity. The receiver fills only on a completed connection.
